test_title: PYST 52: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Goldsmith : Ornaments :: Sculptor : ?
solution:
**Logic :** Artist : Creation

__
 
• **Goldsmith** creates **ornaments**.

Similarly,

 
• **Sculptor** creates **busts**.

Hence, **"Busts"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sand → Sand artists works on sand art.
 
• Museum → It is a building in which objects of historical, scientific, artistic or cultural interest are stored and exhibited.
 
• Stone → Sculptors are the artist who creates figures out of stone.
 
• Bust → It is a carved or cast representation of the head (or head and neck)
